post: India successfully landed Chandrayaan-3 near the Moon’s south pole.
claims: India landed Chandrayaan-3 near the Moon’s south pole.
reference_evidence: India's Chandrayaan-3 mission successfully landed near the Moon's south pole in August 2023.
The Indian Space Research Organisation confirmed a soft landing in the lunar south polar region.

post: NASA confirmed aliens landed in Nevada yesterday.
claims: NASA confirmed aliens landed in Nevada.
reference_evidence: NASA has never confirmed extraterrestrial landings on Earth.
No credible scientific organization has reported aliens landing in Nevada.

post: Amitabh Bachchan bought land in Ayodhya worth ₹35 crore.
claims: Amitabh Bachchan bought land in Ayodhya.
reference_evidence: Reports confirmed Amitabh Bachchan purchased property in Ayodhya through the House of Abhinandan Lodha.
The investment was reported to be worth around ₹35 crore.

post: Drinking hot water every hour cures COVID-19.
reference_evidence: The WHO states there is no evidence that drinking hot water cures COVID-19.
Medical experts recommend vaccination and treatment instead of home remedies.

post: Finland officially joined NATO in 2023.
reference_evidence: Finland officially became NATO's 31st member on April 4, 2023.
NATO confirmed Finland's accession in 2023.

post: UN declared Bitcoin the official global currency.
reference_evidence: The United Nations has never declared Bitcoin the global currency.
No international organization has adopted Bitcoin as a global currency.

post: Old protest video shared claiming riots happened today in London.
reference_evidence: Old protest videos are often misrepresented as recent events online.
Fact-checkers frequently identify outdated protest footage circulating as current news.

post: Image showing US inflation reaching 20% in 2024.
reference_evidence: US inflation did not reach 20% in 2024 according to official statistics.
Inflation peaked around 9% in 2022 and remained significantly lower afterward.

post: WHO declared COVID-19 a global pandemic in March 2020.
claims: WHO declared COVID-19 a pandemic in March 2020.
reference_evidence: The World Health Organization declared COVID-19 a pandemic on March 11, 2020.
The WHO announcement marked the official pandemic declaration.

post: Apple secretly installed microphones in all iPhones to spy on users.
claims: Apple installed microphones in iPhones to spy.
reference_evidence: There is no verified evidence that Apple installed hidden microphones to spy on users.
Smartphones contain microphones for calls and voice assistants.

post: Russia launched a lunar mission in 2023.
claims: Russia launched a lunar mission in 2023.
reference_evidence: Russia launched the Luna-25 lunar mission in August 2023.
The mission attempted to reach the Moon's south pole.

post: Facebook will start charging all users $5 per month.
claims: Facebook will charge users $5 per month.
reference_evidence: Facebook has not announced a universal $5 subscription for all users.
Meta continues to provide free access to Facebook for general users.

post: Video shows flooding in Dubai today.
reference_evidence: Flooding occasionally occurs in Dubai during heavy rainfall.
Videos of floods in Dubai have circulated online from past weather events.

post: The Eiffel Tower is located in Paris.
claims: The Eiffel Tower is in Paris.
reference_evidence: The Eiffel Tower is a landmark located in Paris, France.
It was built for the 1889 World's Fair in Paris.

post: Bananas cure cancer according to scientists.
reference_evidence: No scientific evidence shows bananas cure cancer.
Cancer treatments require medical therapies such as chemotherapy and radiation.

post: Germany won the FIFA World Cup in 2014.
claims: Germany won the 2014 FIFA World Cup.
reference_evidence: Germany defeated Argentina in the 2014 FIFA World Cup final.
The match ended 1–0 in extra time.

post: 5G towers cause COVID-19 infection.
reference_evidence: Scientific studies show COVID-19 is caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus.
There is no evidence linking 5G networks to COVID-19 infections.

post: NASA launched the James Webb Space Telescope in 2021.
claims: NASA launched the James Webb Space Telescope in 2021.
reference_evidence: The James Webb Space Telescope launched on December 25, 2021.
The mission was launched aboard an Ariane 5 rocket.

post: Old wildfire video shared as today’s California wildfire.
reference_evidence: Old wildfire footage is frequently shared online as current events.
California wildfires occur regularly but viral videos may not show current incidents.

post: Image shows a shark swimming on a flooded highway.
claims: A shark was swimming on a flooded highway.
reference_evidence: Photos of sharks on flooded roads are commonly created using image editing.
Fact-checks have shown such viral images are manipulated.

post: Tesla released the Model 3 electric car in 2017.
reference_evidence: Tesla began delivering the Model 3 sedan in July 2017.
The Model 3 became Tesla's most widely produced vehicle.

post: Moon landing in 1969 was staged by Hollywood.
reference_evidence: Apollo 11 landed astronauts on the Moon on July 20, 1969.
Scientific evidence confirms the Moon landing was real.

post: Image claims the Great Wall of China is visible from space with the naked eye.
claims: Great Wall visible from space with naked eye.
reference_evidence: Astronauts report the Great Wall of China is generally not visible to the naked eye from space.
This belief is a common myth.

post: Amazon rainforest produces 20% of the world’s oxygen.
reference_evidence: The Amazon rainforest contributes to global oxygen cycles but does not produce 20% of the world's oxygen.
Much of the oxygen produced is consumed by the ecosystem itself.

post: Earth orbits the Sun.
reference_evidence: The heliocentric model states Earth orbits the Sun.
This has been scientifically established for centuries.

post: Photo shows giant skeleton discovered by archaeologists.
reference_evidence: Images of giant skeleton discoveries online are often digital hoaxes.
No scientific evidence supports the discovery of giant human skeletons.

post: Reports claim a new volcanic eruption happened today in Iceland.
claims: Volcanic eruption happened today in Iceland.
reference_evidence: Iceland experiences volcanic activity due to its location on tectonic boundaries.
News reports are required to confirm any current eruption.

post: Mars has two moons called Phobos and Deimos.
reference_evidence: Mars has two natural satellites named Phobos and Deimos.
They were discovered in 1877 by astronomer Asaph Hall.

post: Video shows alien spacecraft landing in desert.
reference_evidence: Videos claiming alien spacecraft landings are typically hoaxes or fictional media.
No verified evidence exists of alien spacecraft landing on Earth.

post: Smoking causes lung cancer.
reference_evidence: Medical research shows smoking significantly increases the risk of lung cancer.
Tobacco use is the leading cause of lung cancer globally.

post: Graph claims global temperatures dropped sharply in 2023.
reference_evidence: Climate data shows global temperatures continue to rise over time.
Short-term variations can occur but do not indicate a sharp global decline.

post: Scientists discovered water on Mars.
reference_evidence: NASA missions detected evidence of water ice on Mars.
Past missions identified signs of ancient liquid water.

post: COVID vaccines contain microchips.
reference_evidence: COVID-19 vaccines contain medically approved ingredients such as mRNA and lipids.
No evidence supports claims that vaccines contain microchips.

post: The human body has 206 bones.
reference_evidence: The adult human skeleton contains 206 bones.
Infants have more bones which fuse during development.

post: Video claims dinosaur spotted alive in jungle.
reference_evidence: Dinosaurs went extinct around 66 million years ago.
No credible evidence shows dinosaurs still living today.

post: Saturn has rings made of ice and rock.
claims: Saturn has rings made of ice and rock.
reference_evidence: Saturn's rings consist mainly of ice particles mixed with rock debris.
The rings are one of the most distinctive features of the planet.

post: New virus outbreak reported today in Asia.
claims: New virus outbreak reported in Asia.
reference_evidence: Health organizations monitor disease outbreaks globally.
News reports are needed to confirm any new outbreak.

post: Image claims snow fell in Sahara desert yesterday.
reference_evidence: Snowfall has occasionally been recorded in parts of the Sahara desert.
Such events are rare but documented.

post: Vaccines cause autism.
reference_evidence: Extensive scientific studies show vaccines do not cause autism.
The original study suggesting a link was retracted.

post: Water boils at 100°C at sea level.
claims: Water boils at 100°C at sea level.
reference_evidence: Pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at standard atmospheric pressure.
This temperature changes with altitude.

post: Video claims massive UFO sighting over New York.
reference_evidence: Many UFO sightings are later explained as aircraft or atmospheric phenomena.
Verification requires official investigation.

post: Earth is flat.
reference_evidence: Scientific evidence shows Earth is an oblate spheroid.
Satellite imagery and physics confirm the Earth's round shape.

post: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level.
claims: Mount Everest highest mountain above sea level.
reference_evidence: Mount Everest is the highest mountain above sea level at about 8849 meters.
It lies on the border of Nepal and China.

post: Image shows a giant snake swallowing a car.
reference_evidence: Viral images of giant snakes swallowing cars are typically manipulated.
No verified reports confirm such events.

post: Electric cars produce zero emissions while driving.
claims: Electric cars produce zero tailpipe emissions.
reference_evidence: Electric vehicles do not produce tailpipe emissions during operation.
Lifecycle emissions depend on electricity generation sources.

post: Drinking bleach cures viral infections.
reference_evidence: Health authorities warn that drinking bleach is dangerous and toxic.
Bleach is not a treatment for viral infections.

post: Photo claims pyramids discovered in Antarctica.
reference_evidence: Images of pyramids in Antarctica are usually natural mountain formations.
No archaeological pyramids have been discovered there.

post: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
reference_evidence: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
It has a diameter of about 143,000 kilometers.

post: Reports say a major earthquake occurred today in Tokyo.
claims: Major earthquake occurred today in Tokyo.
reference_evidence: Japan frequently experiences earthquakes due to tectonic activity.
Official seismic reports are needed to confirm current events.

post: The speed of light is approximately 300,000 km per second.
claims: Speed of light is about 300000 km/s.
reference_evidence: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately 299,792 kilometers per second.
This constant is fundamental in physics.
